senses.zh_definition: 克劳迪娅：女性名字，在马来语文本中作为人名使用。
senses.en_definition: A feminine given name, used as a proper noun in Malay texts.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan yang digunakan untuk merujuk kepada seseorang bernama Claudia.
senses.nuances: 通常写作Claudia，首字母大写。输入未提供DBP释义，因此本条不标为官方马来语词目；马来语释义为说明性编写。IPA为一种常见英语读法，其他语言及本人读法可能不同。音节与爪夷文缺值保留null；排名仅沿用输入。以下为自然使用组合，未经语料频率验证。名字源流参见[Online Etymology Dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Claudia)。

etymology.historical_story: Claudia is the feminine counterpart of Latin Claudius, a name associated with ancient Roman families. Its deeper history is sometimes connected with Latin claudus, meaning lame, but that connection is uncertain. In present-day use, Claudia identifies a person; its historical associations do not describe the bearer’s appearance, character, or abilities. [Source](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Claudia).
